steps: Title: tapped big yellow Take office as Saudi Arabia
Saw strike scene and tension 76 to 82
Tried to continue debrief: taps lagged or did nothing; later landed on month 2 desk; Approve 4 and Execute did not respond
scenarios.notes: Started in about 15 s and first big moment at about 1 min, good. Then the app got sluggish and I could not progress.

steps: Never reached an end card or any shareable result
scenarios.notes: Only saw the month 1 debrief card, which is screenshot-worthy but not a share card.

friction.where: Title, today's crisis banner vs selected card
friction.expected: Today's crisis is what I play
friction.happened: Banner says Hormuz Convoy but the card selected is Bab al-Mandab Burning, button says Saudi Arabia; confusing
Same paragraph twice (italic intro and Your mission box), pure text wall
Hint box, header meters, mission chip, 6 labels, small bottom sheet; lots of words (A massive air campaign... paragraph) before the options
Taps on Diplomacy tab and the Diplomacy next button timed out or did nothing; screenshots hung for 30 s; page seemed frozen
Taps did nothing visible, twice; ghost text from the previous screen faded behind the new one
Salman on After the Riyadh airport strike: Bomb Sanaa, reads like a bug

bugs.title: UI becomes unresponsive after Execute month on phone viewport
steps: Try tapping debrief tabs, Next, then Approve 4 and Execute on month 2
bugs.actual: Clicks time out at 4 s, screenshots time out at 30 s, taps do nothing; Escape key did move on to the next month

bugs.title: Debrief headline grammar
bugs.actual: Salman on After the Riyadh airport strike: Bomb Sanaa

bugs.title: Briefing text duplicated
bugs.actual: Same paragraph in italic and in mission box

suggestions.what: Make the first month one screen: a big picture, 3 big buttons, no hint box
Give a share card right after the first month debrief
Make taps respond instantly and keep animations light on phones

delight: Title globe with pulsing crisis pins and a giant yellow button, I started in 15 seconds (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-00/shots/noah-phone/001-title.png)
Bomb Sanaa gave a jet strike scene and tension jumped 76 to 82 with red bars, that was the big moment (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-00/shots/noah-phone/005-exec1.png)

fun.reason: The one bomb was fun, then it stalled

clarity.reason: Too many labels and words on the desk, banner and card mismatch

visual.reason: Scenes and globe look like a real game

feels_like_a_game.reason: Looks like one but lags and stuck taps break it

agency.reason: Taps stopped working and I did not know why

realism.reason: Real names and events, I did not check more

replay.reason: I would not come back if it freezes

recommend.reason: Looks cool but froze on my phone before anything else happened

quit_point: About 5 minutes in, month 2 desk: tapped Approve 4 and Execute month, nothing happened twice after the debrief already felt stuck.
verbatim: The bomb part was sick, but then it froze and I just closed it.
